content.text:
Night waking at 8 can flare up with school stress, screen time close to bed, or a shifted sleep schedule - it's more common than it feels at 2am. A consistent wind-down routine starting 30-45 min before bed (dim lights, no screens, same order every night) is the most reliable reset.

Want the full night-by-night plan for getting Ada back to solid sleep? Reply YES and I'll send it.
